data.title: S.Pellegrino Young Chef Academy announces Asia regional final in Bangkok
data.description: S.Pellegrino Young Chef Academy has announced that the Asia regional final of its 2026-27 competition will take place on Oct 20 at Le Cordon Bleu Dusit Culinary Arts School in Bangkok.

data.title: 76 deaths attributed to floods since mid-September
data.description: Seventy-six people have died across Thailand since mid-September because of flooding, including 25 in Prachin Buri province alone, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.

data.title: School roof collapse kills 28 people in Pakistan
data.description: PESHAWAR, Pakistan - Twenty-seven pupils and a teacher were killed on Thursday after a roof collapsed at a school in the northwest Pakistani city of Peshawar, a hospital official said.

data.title: Orange skies in Indonesia as haze crisis spreads
data.description: PALANGKARAYA, Indonesia - Thick haze turned the skies in this Central Kalimantan city apocalyptic shades of yellow and orange on Thursday, reducing visibility to a few dozen metres as wildfires cause a regional air pollution crisis.

data.title: Pope has ‘good night’ in hospital, Vatican says
data.description: ROME - Pope Leo XIV had a “good night” in hospital and has eaten breakfast as he recovers from lung cancer surgery, the Vatican said Thursday.

data.title: Swiss president making first Thai visit in 22 years
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Thursday welcomed Swiss President Guy Parmelin for an official visit aimed at expanding trade and investment and strengthening bilateral cooperation, as the two countries prepare to mark the 95th anniversary of diplomatic relations.

data.title: Chinese woman held on suspicion of people-smuggling
data.description: SONGKHLA - Immigration police have arrested a Chinese former flight attendant who is suspected of acting as a broker for a human smuggling network that helps foreigners across the Thai-Malaysian border.

data.title: Ma Jun urges shared green standards to cut financing costs
data.description: At an SCBX and SCB dialogue in Bangkok, Ma Jun outlined how compatible green rules, staff training and technology could expand sustainable finance.

data.title: California puts first US billionaire tax to a vote
data.description: LOS ANGELES - When Americans vote in next month’s midterm elections, one question on the ballot in California could echo far beyond the state: should the ultra-wealthy pay a special tax on their fortunes?

data.title: School headscarf ban meets resistance in Austria
data.description: VIENNA - As the new school year gets under way in Austria, a headscarf ban for girls under 14 has sparked protests on the streets and in the classroom, with dozens of pupils refusing to comply.

data.title: Costa Rica opens El Salvador-inspired mega-prison
data.description: ALAJUELA, Costa Rica - Costa Rica opened a high-security jail on Wednesday inspired by a mega-prison in El Salvador that has become a symbol of the country’s war on gangs, widely criticized by human rights groups.

data.title: ‘High hopes’ as Indonesian women’s football league returns
data.description: JAKARTA - Seven years after Covid-19 put the brakes on Indonesia’s new women’s football league, Zahra Naqiyyah will finally return to the field with “high hopes” for the women’s game in the country.

data.title: Chinese fugitive with Privilege visa arrested in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - Police have arrested a Chinese man with an expired visa in a rented house in the middle of a forest on this southern tourist island, after learning was wanted for allegedly running an illegal casino.

data.title: Bayer, GIZ and BCIU collaborate for sustainable, low-carbon rice systems
data.description: Bayer, in cooperation with the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH, and together with the Business Council for International Understanding (BCIU), hosted the event "Securing the Future of Rice: Innovation and Partnerships Advancing Food Security, Climate Resilience and Low-Carbon Rice Systems" in Bangkok. On the sidelines of the World Bank and IMF fall meetings, this flagship event brought together government, industry and development partners to discuss the future of rice production in Asia.

data.title: New four-lane bridge opens between China, North Korea
data.description: DANDONG, China - A new four-lane road bridge linking China and North Korea finally opened on Thursday, 12 years late, enabling the Asian giant and its isolated nuclear-armed neighbour to step up cross-border trade substantially.

data.title: Nene Royal wows government’s hi-so dinner guests
data.description: From wowing headbangers in Singapore to livening up a dinner for the planet’s financial elite, it’s been another eventful week for Nene Royal, the young Phuket rocker and winner of this year’s “America’s Got Talent” grand prize.

data.title: A unique identity: Pascal Jolivet on Sauvignon Blanc and the art of winemaking
data.description: The world of wine is no stranger to Maison Pascal Jolivet, founded in France in 1987 by its namesake.

data.title: Mobile clinics battle childhood dental ‘disaster’ in Mongolia
data.description: ULAANBAATAR - Inside a traditional Mongolian ger in the sprawling suburbs of Ulaanbaatar, children queue to have their teeth checked at a mobile dental practice that roams the vast country, providing treatment that is hard to come by in remote areas.

data.title: UN sounds alarm on growing poverty after Iran war shock
data.description: Millions could be thrown into poverty by surging energy costs, the impact of an intense El Nino phenomenon and higher interest rates, with vulnerable countries being pushed to the brink by repeated crises, says the United Nations’ development chief.

data.title: Demonstrators stopped near IMF meeting venue
data.description: Demonstrators gathered on Thursday morning near the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, the venue of IMF-World Bank Group meetings, but were prevented by police from advancing.

data.title: Siam Music Yamaha Awards 700k Baht Gear to Champion Marching Band
data.description: Marking another proud milestone for Thailand’s music community on the global stage, the Ratchasima Witthayalai Marching Band has achieved extraordinary success by capturing championship titles and prestigious honours at international music competitions in Europe.

data.title: Australia fights ‘unfettered’ access to children by big tech
data.description: SYDNEY - Australia said on Thursday it refused to allow big tech to have “unfettered” access to its children as it formally introduced new legislation that would give users choice over what they see on their feeds.

data.title: Asians swept up in Cornell rape case ‘witch hunt’
data.description: WASHINGTON - One message told him to “go to hell.” Others said he deserved to be imprisoned. Death threats poured in.

data.title: Australia says won't let big tech have 'unfettered' access to kids
data.description: SYDNEY - Australia said Thursday it refused to allow big tech to have "unfettered" access to its kids as it formally introduced new legislation that would give users choice over what they see on their feeds.

data.title: Healthy corals help bleached neighbours recover, study finds
data.description: WASHINGTON - The world's coral reefs face an existential threat from rising seawater temperatures that trigger widespread bleaching, a problem driven by climate change and compounded by this year's intense El Nino phenomenon.
